description: Somalia flooding Belet Weyne Town, Belet Weyne District, Hiiran Region is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT produced satellite-detected flood water extent and IDP distribtuion within the town of Belet Weyne in Belet Weyne District,Hiiran Region, Somalia. The analysis was conducted analyzing GeoEye-1 & WorldView-3 images acquired on the 30 April & 1 May 2018. Coverage: Somalia. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are flooding, geodata. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2024-12-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source.
